name: palcms
description: Open-source CMS for Palworld dedicated servers: installer, public website and admin panel

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,palworld,market -c blue,magenta,green,yellow "pnpm --filter @palcms/server dev" "pnpm --filter @palcms/web dev" "node tools/fake-palworld-api/server.mjs" "node tools/fake-market/server.mjs"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @palcms/web build && pnpm --filter @palcms/server build && node sdk/palcms-ext.mjs site-classes apps/web/dist/assets
